# Your Daily Running Brief — 24 July 2026

Hey! Data's gone a bit quiet on me today — no activity, sleep, HRV, or step data came through for yesterday, so I'm working blind on the specifics. It happens, don't worry!

Without recovery markers to read, I can't confidently say whether your body is primed or pleading for rest. The honest advice here is to tune into how you *actually feel* this morning — legs heavy, sleep quality, general energy. That's your best data point right now.

On nutrition, keep today simple and consistent: hit your 2,300 kcal and prioritise those 175g of protein regardless of what training looks like. With 69 days to Chester, every day of solid fuelling compounds. If your sync issues persist, check your device is charging and app permissions are active — that data continuity really matters for smart training decisions. You've got this! 💪
